appDescription.message: Find audible tabs automatically and control mute. Connect tab volume and EQ with the extension button or Command+Shift+6.

actionTitle.message: Connect or disconnect this tab from TX · MAC

audioPurpose.message: Process tab volume and EQ locally and restore original audio when the app disconnects. No recording.

noAudioResponse.message: No response from the tab audio processor.

detectedTooltip.message: Audible tab detected. Connect volume/EQ: click or Command+Shift+6.

controlledTooltip.message: TX · MAC connected. Click or Command+Shift+6 to restore original playback.

waitingTooltip.message: Tab audio connected; waiting for the Mac mixer. Original volume is playing. Click to disconnect.

nativeDisconnected.message: Mac app disconnected. Restoring original volume and mute.

invalidCapture.message: Valid tab capture information is required.

cannotPlay.message: Cannot play tab audio. Press the extension button again.
